paper_title: DART Distilling Autoregressive Reasoning to Silent Thought
caption: Accuracy and inference time on GSM8K with varying C, the number of ST tokens.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the effect of varying the ST Token Number C on Accuracy (%) and Inference time (ms). The x-axis, labeled "ST Token Number $C$", features a linear scale ranging from 0 to 30, with numeric tick labels spaced at intervals of 5. The plot utilizes dual y-axes: the left y-axis is labeled "Accuracy (%)" and uses a linear scale ranging from 36 to 43 with tick intervals of 1, while the right y-axis is labeled "Inference time (ms)" and uses a linear scale ranging from 33 to 40, also with tick intervals of 1. A solid blue line with circular markers tracks "Accuracy (%)" according to the left y-axis; it begins at approximately 36.8 at an x-value of 0, rises sharply to roughly 39.6 at an x-value of 1 and 42.0 at an x-value of 6, dips slightly to 41.2 at an x-value of 10, reaches a peak of 42.6 at an x-value of 20, and concludes at about 42.1 at an x-value of 30. A solid red line with square markers tracks "Inference time (ms)" according to the right y-axis; it exhibits a relatively steady trend, starting at approximately 36.4 at an x-value of 0, dropping slightly to 36.3 at an x-value of 1, rising to 36.5 at an x-value of 6, and slowly increasing from 36.4 at an x-value of 10 to end at roughly 36.8 at an x-value of 30.
